scheme_name: Scheme for Supply of TV Sets to Industrial Establishments/Labour Welfare Centres/Clubs/Recreation Rooms
other_conditions: The applicant must be an Industrial Establishment or Labour Welfare Centre run by the Government of Goa
The applicant may be a Club or Recreation Room run by a Registered Trade Union that has 300 or more members
Preference is given to applicants situated in labour‑concentrated areas
The beneficiary establishment must enter into an agreement with the Goa Labour Welfare Board to keep the TV set in good working condition and exhibit programmes for workers on a daily basis
benefits_summary: One coloured TV set (up to ₹25,000) including all accessories is provided to the eligible establishment.
